tool.name: qiime2 sidle reconstruct-counts
tool.description: Reconstructs multiple aligned regions into a count table.
tool.command: export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="\$PWD/xdgconfig" MPLCONFIGDIR="\$PWD/mplconfigdir" NUMBA_CACHE_DIR="\$PWD/numbacache" CONDA_PREFIX=/opt/conda/envs/sidle-0.1.0-beta && q2galaxy run sidle reconstruct_counts '$inputs'

param.name: regional_alignment
param.label: Regional alignments
param.help: [required] A mapping between the kmer names (in the kmer map) and the features (found in the regional table)

param.name: regional_table
param.label: Regional count tables
param.help: [required] A feature-table for each region, where the features in the table correspond to the ASVs which were aligned in the regional alignment artifact

param.name: database_map
param.label: Database reconstruction map
param.help: [required] A map between the final kmer name and the original database sequence. Useful for reconstructing taxonomy and trees.

param.name: database_summary
param.label: Database reconstruction summary
param.help: [required] A summary of the statitics for the regional map describing the number of regions mapped to each reference sequence and the number of kmers. The kmer mapping estimate can account for degeneracy when the `--count-degenerates` flag is used or can ignore degenrate sequences in mapping

repeat.name: region
repeat.help: [required] The name of the sub region used in alignment. The region names do not matter, however, the region order must match the order along the hypervariable region.
repeat.title: region: List[Str]

param.name: element
param.label: Element
param.validator: value is not None and len(value) > 0

param.name: per_nucleotide_error
param.label: Per nucleotide error
param.help: [default: 0.005] The assumed per-nucelotide error rate throughout amplification and sequencing.

param.name: min_abund
param.label: Minimum relative abundance
param.help: [default: 1e-05] The minimum frequency for a feature to be retained during reconstruction. The default from the original smurf algorithm is 1e-10, the number here may depend on the total number of sequences in your sample.

param.name: region_normalize
param.label: Region normalize
param.help: [default: 'average'] Whether the relative abundance should be normalized by region during reconstruction. When using kmer-based alignment to reconstruct multiple regions within a single sample, this is most appropriate. In meta-analysis, region normalization may increase count retention.

param.name: block_size
param.label: Block size
param.help: [default: 10000] The number of sequences to use in parallel computation. The larger the block_size, the faster processing can happen, but more the memory that will be required.

param.name: min_counts
param.label: Minimum sample counts
param.help: [default: 1000] The mininum depth across all regions after alignment for a sample to be included in a reconstruction.

param.name: debug
param.label: Run without a parallel client
param.help: [default: No] Whether the function should be run in debug mode (without a client) or not. `debug` superceeds all options.

param.name: n_workers
param.label: Parallel workers
param.help: [default: 1] The number of jobs to initiate.

tool.help:
QIIME 2: sidle reconstruct-counts ================================= Reconstructs multiple aligned regions into a count table.
Outputs: -------- :reconstructed_table.qza: The feature table with the reconstructed abundance using ASVs from all regions mapped to database sequences.
|
Description: ------------ This takes multiple regional alignments and regional counts and reconstructs them into a single table with region-normalized abundance counts.
|
